title: content/home/home.json
description: M7-04 — the loc keys the Home screen (S03) renders. What is fixed here is that the screen shows a Legend Level label, an Energy label, an Energy Reserve label, the HUD tiles' captions (Crowns, Soul Shards, Gold, Power, Progress, Stage, and the three tier names the progress tile spells a clear with), one primary action caption per run decision, one status line per state the screen can be in while it has nothing to act on, and the line a progress tile shows before anything is cleared — and that every one of them is a key rather than a literal (X-04). The currency and tier captions are keys other documents own; they are named here as well so that Home's dependence on them is a reference the loader checks rather than a literal in a presenter. Every value is a loc key, so ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences resolves it against every locale file: a key this document names but a locale does not carry fails the build, and a locale string this document stops naming fails it as an orphan. additionalProperties is false on every object so the absences are enforced rather than merely observed: there is no member for an Energy maximum, a regeneration countdown, a Legend-XP percentage or a run Energy cost, because those are functions of tuning that only Core can evaluate and a slot here would invite a second copy of the formula.

locKey.description: loc.<domain>.<id>.<field>, lowercase, dot-separated, snake_case segments — the same shape schema/loc.schema.json governs the locale files by.

label.description: The captions beside the header values the player snapshot carries, and the HUD tiles' captions. Energy and Energy Reserve are two separate banks and are labelled separately: one caption over both would read as a single pool, which is not what the state says. crowns, soulShards and gold name the currency names, and tierNormal, tierHeroic and tierMythic name Chapter Select's tier names: keys those documents own, declared here because the HUD renders them and a dependency the loader cannot see is one a retired key breaks silently.

action.description: The primary button, in the two shapes the run decision can take. Two captions rather than one parameterised caption: 'start a new run' and 'resume the run you are in' send the player to different places, and a screen that says the same word for both is a screen a player cannot read.

status.description: The line shown while the screen has no decision to offer — the read has not answered yet, the read said there is no such profile, the run the player left has lapsed — and the one line a tile shows in place of a value: nothingCleared is what the progress tile says on a profile that has cleared no chapter. The CAUSE beyond that is carried in code as a named state so it can be logged and told apart, while what a player is shown stays one honest sentence.
